Skewness and kurtosis are reported for the normality option.
Item-deleted columns show Cronbach's alpha and Pearson omega after removing each item.
Corrected item-total correlation uses the total score excluding the item; item-total correlation uses the full total score.
A dash (-) indicates that the coefficient could not be estimated for that item-deleted model.
alpha = Cronbach's alpha or ordinal alpha
omega = Pearson omega or ordinal omega
